title: Ouzoud Falls Day Escape
description: A full day at Morocco's most famous waterfalls: walk down the olive-grove path, boat ride under the falls, lunch with a view, and meet the Barbary macaques.

title: Lakes & Kasbahs — 2 Days
description: Turquoise water and hilltop forts: Bin El Ouidane lake, boat trip, sunset from the dam, then Aïn Asserdoun spring and the kasbah above Béni Mellal.

title: Happy Valley Trek — Aït Bouguemez
description: 3 days of gentle trekking between Amazigh villages, granaries, and green fields in the Aït Bouguemez valley, with nights in family guesthouses.

title: Cedar Forests & Mountain Lakes
description: Discover the Khénifra National Park side of the region: Aguelmame Azigza lake, the Oum Er-Rbia springs, and a picnic under the cedars.

title: Dinosaur Tracks & Geopark Day
description: A family-friendly geology day: real dinosaur footprints at Iouaridène, the natural bridge of Imi n'Ifri, and the M'Goun Geopark house.
